skill.name: framework-migration-code-migrate
skill.description: A code migration assistant for planning framework, language, API, database, and platform migrations with testing and rollback guidance.
skill.summary: Plan structured code migrations with risk analysis, phased execution, testing, and rollback guidance.

content.value_statement: Large code migrations create risk when scope, dependencies, and rollback steps are unclear. This skill structures analysis, planning, examples, testing, and rollback guidance for controlled migrations.
actual_capabilities: Assesses migration scope, complexity, dependencies, and risks.
Builds phased migration plans with milestones and rollback steps.
Provides examples for React to Vue, Python 2 to 3, REST to GraphQL, and SQL to NoSQL migrations.
Designs comparison testing for functionality, performance, data integrity, and API behavior.
Outlines automation patterns for migration analysis, CLI execution, monitoring, and reporting.
limitations: Does not execute migrations or validate code without tool support.
Generated scripts require review before use in production.
Framework-specific details depend on the source code and target version.
Large migrations may need manual architecture decisions and stakeholder approval.

use_cases.title: Plan Legacy Modernization
use_cases.description: Create a migration roadmap with phases, risks, milestones, and rollback criteria for a legacy application.

use_cases.title: Convert API and Data Patterns
use_cases.description: Map REST, GraphQL, SQL, and NoSQL patterns before generating migration examples and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Validate Migrated Behavior
use_cases.description: Define comparison tests for functionality, performance, data integrity, and user flows after migration.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment for a new migration request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this codebase for migration from [source] to [target]. Identify scope, dependencies, risks, and missing inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Phased Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for a framework or version migration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased migration plan for [framework/version] to [target]. Include tasks, milestones, tests, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Design Migration Examples
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed guidance for a specific module or interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show migration examples for [component/API/data model]. Explain the old pattern, target pattern, edge cases, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Enterprise Runbook
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for multi-service migration programs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a runbook for staged migration across [services]. Include owners, sequencing, automation points, monitoring, rollback, and acceptance gates.

output_examples.input: Migrate a React component library to Vue.
output_examples.output: A phased plan with component inventory, lifecycle mapping, state conversion guidance, risk items, tests, and rollback checkpoints.
A migration checklist covering syntax changes, dependency updates, automated transformations, compatibility tests, and staged deployment steps.

output_examples.input: Move a REST API to GraphQL.
output_examples.output: A mapping plan for resources, queries, mutations, response types, resolver behavior, validation tests, and client rollout.

best_practices: Start with an inventory of dependencies, runtime versions, and unsupported APIs.
Use incremental migration phases with automated comparison tests after each phase.
Keep rollback criteria explicit before changing production traffic.
anti_patterns: Do not migrate all modules at once without feature flags or staged validation.
Do not run generated migration scripts against production without review and backups.
Do not treat syntax conversion as proof of functional equivalence.

faq.question: Can this skill migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: It can draft plans and example scripts. Execution still requires user tools, review, tests, and environment access.

faq.question: Which migrations does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers framework, language, API, database, platform, and version migrations at a planning and example level.

faq.question: Does it include rollback planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for rollback triggers, procedures, verification steps, and communication plans.

faq.question: Can it validate migrated behavior?
faq.answer: It can design comparison tests for functionality, performance, data integrity, API compatibility, and user flows.

faq.question: Is production use safe?
faq.answer: Generated scripts should be reviewed, tested in staging, and backed by a rollback plan before production use.

faq.question: Does it replace architecture decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning, but teams still decide target architecture, rollout order, and acceptance criteria.
